supersedes_nothing: The v1 component's contract, schema, data-sufficiency statement, builder, checks and all 12 artifacts are untouched evidence of what v1 actually asserted. This is a NEW EXPLICITLY VERSIONED SIBLING that repairs the INFERENCE STRENGTH of v1's labels. No v1 byte was opened for writing (checks V1, V12).
scope_of_this_repair: Labels and prose only. No source query, no re-run of job 2, no re-run of any leaf analysis, no manuscript edit, no new rate, unique-patient total, capacity bound or control analysis. The endpoint paper stays parked.
the_defect: Different preserved strings establish NON-IDENTICAL ENCODINGS. They do not establish that a pair is a genuinely distinct clinical measurement or population. v1's sentences 'Genuinely duplicate encodings do not occur' and 'every one ... a distinct outcome, time point or population' are WITHDRAWN as v2 statements.
no_normalisation: No normalisation of unit order, signs, case, spacing or misspellings is performed anywhere. No record is merged. No preferred endpoint is introduced.

encoding_identity_status.NON_IDENTICAL_ENCODING_ON_PRESERVED_FIEL: the competing observations differ on at least one preserved identity field. This establishes that the ENCODINGS are not identical and nothing more. Observed: 4464 cohort keys
encoding_identity_status.IDENTICAL_ON_ALL_PRESERVED_FIELDS: no preserved field separates the competing observations. Observed: 0. Its absence is NOT evidence that semantic duplication is absent
encoding_identity_status.SINGLE_OBSERVATION__NO_COMPARISON_MADE: one observation for this cohort key; no comparison was possible. Observed: 4276

semantic_duplication_status.UNRESOLVED__SEMANTIC_CORRESPONDENCE_NOT_: whether the competing observations are the same measurement on the same patients is NOT established by the source and is not decided here. Carried on all 4464 competing sets
semantic_duplication_status.NOT_APPLICABLE__SINGLE_OBSERVATION: only one observation exists for this cohort key

distinction_basis.TEXT_DERIVED_ONLY: the only differing fields are free-text source strings or tokens derived from them (measure title, time-frame text, population description, unitOfMeasure text, endpoint-construct tokens, criteria and version tokens). Observed: 1744 competing sets. This is exactly the case the negative control shows is not evidence of a distinct measurement
distinction_basis.INCLUDES_STRUCTURED_FIELD: at least one differing field is structured: paramType, the Participants denominator value, the outcome-measure type, or the denominator state. Observed: 2720 competing sets
distinction_basis.NONE: no differing field, or no comparison made

relation_status.SOURCE_STATED_PARENT_COMPONENT_RELATION_: an exact record field enumerates the component groups or states the pooling arithmetic. The field name and its verbatim text are recorded. Observed: 11 of 47
relation_status.SOURCE_DESCRIBED_SUPERSET_LANGUAGE__COMP: the record uses all-participants/superset language but names no component group, so which cohorts are its components is not established. Observed: 10 of 47
relation_status.CANDIDATE_PARENT_COMPONENT_RELATION__NAM: the only basis is a pooled-sounding normalised group title. A name is NOT evidence of who the patients are; same_patients_claim reads NOT ESTABLISHED. Observed: 26 of 47

conflict_category_presentation.EXACT_LABEL__WITHIN_MEASURE_SUM_EXCEEDS_: 70 trials, disjoint from the other two excess labels
35 trials, disjoint. NOT a subset of the 70
conflict_category_presentation.EXACT_LABEL__SINGLE_COHORT_EXCEEDS_ENROL: 1 trial (NCT00756509, 41 vs 34), disjoint. Its measure holds exactly one group, so its within-measure sum IS that cohort
conflict_category_presentation.MEMBERSHIP__ANY_WITHIN_MEASURE_SUM_EXCES: 106 trials. A NON-EXCLUSIVE membership view and the union of the three labels above. It is not a fourth category and no total is manufactured

denominator_usability_scope: 'Denominator usable' means a positive reported Participants denominator AT THIS COMPONENT'S SCOPE. It is NOT full eligibility, NOT analysis-population membership, and NOT fitness for any downstream estimand.
metadata_state_separation: Source non-collection (639 observations carrying a verbatim non-collection or termination statement) and an absent reportingStatus field (15 observations in 10 trials) are SEPARATE metadata states. Neither is evidence for the other; neither is a missing value; they are never collapsed. Counts are v1 outputs carried forward.
negative_control: negative_control.py: one synthetic record entered twice with harmless wording differences. NC1 v1's rule reports no duplicate candidate, so v1's sentence would call one record twice a distinct outcome/time point/population. NC2 v2 labels it NON_IDENTICAL_ENCODING / TEXT_DERIVED_ONLY / semantics UNRESOLVED. NC3 neither rule merges, normalises or rewrites a clinical record. Exit 0 on all three.
